StampLoad4A.description: Pick a built-in stamp and tint color.

stamp_color.name: Color
stamp_color.tooltip: Tint color for built-in stamps (white+transparent or black ink on white).

stamp_angle.name: Angle
stamp_angle.tooltip: Initial angle used by Stamp Censor when Auto Rotate is off. The preview rotates; the output stamp does not.

StampCustomLoad4A.description: Drop or pick a custom image. Used as-is, no keying or tint.

image.name: Custom Image
image.tooltip: Drag an image onto the node. The file is used as-is; no white-background keying or tint.

stamp_angle.name: Angle
stamp_angle.tooltip: Initial angle used by Stamp Censor when Auto Rotate is off. The preview rotates; the output stamp does not.

StampCensor4A.description: Scatter stamps over masked regions. Connect Stamp from Stamp Load or Stamp Custom Load.

mask.name: Mask
mask.tooltip: White areas are stamped. Each connected region is handled separately.

stamp.name: Stamp
stamp.tooltip: Connect Stamp Load or Stamp Custom Load.

target_coverage.name: Coverage
target_coverage.tooltip: Stop placing stamps in a region when this fraction of its mask is covered.

size_ratio.name: Size Ratio
size_ratio.tooltip: Stamp size as a fraction of the region's longer side, before min/max clamp.

max_size.name: Max Size
max_size.tooltip: Largest stamp size in pixels. Size Ratio usually hits first.

spacing_factor.name: Spacing
spacing_factor.tooltip: Collision size of each stamp. 0 allows full overlap, useful for hollow shapes like a cross. 1.0 = oriented boxes just touch.

size_jitter.name: Size Jitter
size_jitter.tooltip: Random size variation around the base size.

angle_jitter.name: Angle Jitter
angle_jitter.tooltip: Extra random rotation in degrees, added after auto-rotate or the load angle.

auto_rotate.name: Auto Rotate
auto_rotate.tooltip: On: align to each mask region's long axis, then add the Stamp Load angle. Off: use the Stamp Load angle only.

stamp_angle.name: Angle
stamp_angle.tooltip: Copied from Stamp Load. Added on top of auto-rotate when it is on.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Optional. When connected, used for placement. When empty, each queue run is random.
